page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a decorative header above the title. Page number top right. Woodcut initial at the start of the first stanza. Signature mark at the bottom right.

main_text.head: X GALLICA TH. BEZÆ CANTIONE QVÆ SIC INCIPIT.
Seiché de douleur.

p.i: DOlore ficcum languido, Calore coctum feruido Me,Cælitum ô parens,Sides: Adhuc tamen tuum semel umen,quod inuocat,cupit lens nostra laude tollere.
ors dura nigris debile orpus meum circumuolat ennis:sed altas,te duce, estit Volucris Spiritus edes Olympi tangere, uisque Vultibus frui.
Me,corpus inquit, iam premet is Lethi inexorabilis. eruire contrà corpori, Mens inquit,ecce desinam. Nil Vita nunc tecum est mihi Polluta multo crimine.

page.notes: The left edge of the scan cuts off the first letters of several lines; these are copied as far as visible (for example "umen", "lens", "ors", "orpus", "ennis", "is", "eruire"). The large initial D is the woodcut letter. Several marks in the margins and speckles on the scan are not printed text and are left out.
